{"answerable":true,"sql":"WITH price AS (
  SELECT list_price_usd
  FROM t_price_list_2026
  WHERE product = 'Harrier Mini'
), shipped AS (
  SELECT SUM(harrier_mini_units) AS units_shipped
  FROM t_sales_q3_2026_by_region
)
SELECT s.units_shipped, p.list_price_usd
FROM shipped s
CROSS JOIN price p;"}
